fusions.name: Dazzle Spit
fusions.desc: Spits at the first enemy it meets for 4 poison damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Strike from Stillness
fusions.desc: A sudden strike that deals 28 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Dropped Tail
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to drop a writhing tail at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 25 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles sets it off: it deals 20 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Basking Hours
fusions.desc: By day, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
